prompt: A vertical 9:16 photograph looking straight down at a worn doormat just inside a council flat's front door, framed slightly off-centre so the bottom edge of the white door and a strip of patterned carpet cut into the top of the frame. Scattered across the mat lie a gas bill in a window envelope, a supermarket offers leaflet, a takeaway menu, and a postcard-sized flyer half covered by the menu, with the words "SPONSOR A CHANCELLOR" printed in bold white capitals on a black band and a black-and-white photo of the man with a trembling, wounded expression. The toe of an old woman's fleece-lined slipper and the hem of her buttoned brown winter coat enter from the bottom edge. Flat, cold blue-grey light from a frosted door pane, very even and shadowless, with one weak warm glow on the carpet from a lamp out of frame. Shot on slightly grainy 1980s colour negative film, muted colours, low contrast. Thanks.
